properties.name: folders
properties.title: Folders
properties.description: The folders of images a task can show. A task picks one by its name.

properties.name: listMode
properties.title: Slides in a List
properties.description: continue: every slot takes the next items of the list where the last one stopped, and the list is fetched again when it is used up. restart: every slot starts at the top of a new list.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Lists After (days)
properties.description: A kept list that no slot has used for this many days is removed (a feed or folder you stopped showing). 0: never.

properties.name: folder
properties.title: Folder
properties.description: Which folder of images to show. Add folders in the Image Folder data source settings.
